Setup already done on this machine (CLI, env vars, consent, doctor all green). Wired recall/replay/record into `agent.mjs` — this agent's own loop is the harness (not Claude Code itself), so used the CLI-shellout pattern from step 3, matching `02-home-agent` and `03-browser-agent`.

Bug found during test: `memorable show` truncates long step lines (`… (line truncated)`), and `write_note`'s text is long LLM prose that differs every run anyway. Recording it in the command corrupted replay and broke identical-command matching. Fix: record only `path` for `write_note`; replay rebuilds note text from the `fetch` results already replayed in that run (deterministic, same corpus).

```
recall: miss
1. search {"query":"Team plan pricing cost per seat"} -> [...]
2. fetch {"url":"https://blog.example/2026-pricing-change"} -> "We raised Team from $40 to $45 per seat on Sep 1 2026."
3. write_note {"path":"notes/team-price.md", ...} -> {"ok":true}
4. done {...} -> {"ok":true,...}
planner calls: 4 · recall: miss
memorable: stored procedures/94e8082a-add-team-price-note-to-notes-directory, first recording of this task
```
